motion_rule: one clear action per window, only one of them moves at a time; a body crosses the frame edge to edge every window, a moving prop alone never counts; the camera never carries a window alone; he never holds a pose; new shot size every window
character: a glossy red lobster, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie; ONE cook beyond the glass, hands only
props: ONE fish tank; ONE toy castle on the gravel, a big key in its door; ONE potted flower; ONE watering can; ONE pot on a lit stove, ONE lemon; ONE pair of steel tongs; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the pot steams harder each window
environment: the WHOLE clip is INSIDE the glass tank, underwater, gravel floor; the kitchen only through the glass

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, smooth realtor patter, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ku-DA, vlo-ZHIT, ne-DVI-zhi-most, STU-di-yu, u va-DY, KUH-nyu, za-TO svoy, ne-na-DOL-ga
audio.pacing: not a word before 0.9; 0.9-2.7 one breath; one pause, 2.7-3.2; 3.2-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, not a voice over
audio.sfx: glass taps, claw snaps, a lid clang, water pouring, a key turning, a boil, a splash
